statement_record.book: The operad Cospan: (i) types are natural numbers a in N; (ii) an operation of arity (a1,...,an;b) is a cospan a1 + ... + an -> p <- b of finite sets; (iii) substitution is defined by pushout; (iv) id_a is the identity cospan a -> a <- a. statement_record.intree: Cospan_SymmetricMonoidal : @SymmetricMonoidal (CospanCat C HP) with I := the initial object and tensor := the coproduct, over CospanCat C HP whose morphisms are cospans (apex + two legs) composed by pushout; instantiable at C := FinSet by FinSet_HasPushouts
statement_record.strength_comparison: intree-weaker: the book's own gloss — 'the operadic analogue of the symmetric monoidal category (Cospan_FinSet, 0, +)' — is exactly what IS in-tree, at full strength and over an arbitrary base with pushouts, an initial object and coproducts, and witnessed at FinSet.
